title: No queued test fails if a burnt-in image subtitle draws nothing
notes: Gate gap of JS-198 (po-check.md §E; D-20261127-js198-land): the merge queue, which runs before any image is published, is meant to catch this fault; the lead names the queued test that fails if a burnt-in image subtitle draws nothing (invariants 50 and 51 name roles and e2e checks on both stores; unverified). Without such a test it is fixed in JS-198's gate before it lands. Promoted when a published image ships the fault. JS-194's ledger keeps the outcome across the cutover.
